purpose: Candidate conventions for recognizing source, intermediary, recipient, reception and mediation across presentations; not a universal graphic grammar.

mappings.proposal: A persistent, recognizable planetary source region with an accessible label.
mappings.intended_meaning: The source role of the represented relation.
not_asserted: Higher physical altitude or larger size means greater metaphysical power

mappings.proposal: Recognizable living subjects in one coherent region; the whole can be inspected to reveal grass or people.
mappings.intended_meaning: Organic life participates in reception and mediation, rather than serving as decorative terrain.
not_asserted: One organism with a proven shared physiological mechanism

mappings.proposal: A distinct persistent Earth region; recognizable and labeled.
mappings.intended_meaning: The recipient in the reported relationship, distinct from the intermediary.
not_asserted: A separate planet behind the living terrain

mappings.proposal: An approach/contact indication reaches living subjects and terminates there; any motion is explicitly symbolic.
mappings.intended_meaning: The planetary relation is received by organic life.

mappings.proposal: A visually different, locally originated response points from the participating living region toward Earth.
mappings.intended_meaning: Organic life makes the relation receivable by Earth; this differs from the incoming reception role.
not_asserted: A measured output caused by a particular input
Energy conservation, exact transformation ratio, or a physical pulse

artistic_freedom: Recognizable plants, people, textures, atmosphere, narration and captions can supplement the notation.
Stable concept identities do not require identical geometry or colors across films.
This proposal does not establish that a viewer can decode any convention without instruction.
reuse_gate: Test recognition after instruction on another source/intermediary/recipient example; do not promote the conventions on the basis of code reuse alone.
